plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Enterasys switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 5624).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Enterasys switch from ENTERASYS-RESOURCE-UTILIZATION-MIB etsysResourceCpuLoad5min (1.3.6.1.4.1.5624.1.2.49.1.1.1.1.4, 5-minute average). The raw value is percent x10 (0-1000) and is divided by 10 at collection time; the busiest processor is shown.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used RAM of the Enterasys switch in bytes, computed at collection time as etsysResourceStorageSize minus etsysResourceStorageAvailable (KB x1024) over RAM-type rows of etsysResourceStorageTable, summed across modules.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available RAM of the Enterasys switch in bytes, from etsysResourceStorageAvailable (1.3.6.1.4.1.5624.1.2.49.1.3.1.1.5, KB x1024) over RAM-type rows, summed across modules.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: RAM utilization of the Enterasys switch, computed at collection time as (size - available) / size * 100 for each RAM-type row of etsysResourceStorageTable; the highest module value is shown.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
